name: Domain Views Display
description: Allows views to be configured to use different displays based on domain.
project_description: Domain Views Display makes a Views display domain-aware by letting a display hand off to a different display of the same view on specific domains of a Domain (Domain Access) multi-site. It provides one Views display-extender plugin (DomainViewsDisplayExtender, id domain_views_display_display_extender) that adds a 'Domain overrides' section to every display in the Views UI, where a site builder maps each configured domain to the display that should render instead. At runtime a helper (Drupal\domain_views_display\DomainViewsDisplay) reads the active domain from the Domain negotiator and swaps in the mapped display for page routes (by decorating the core ViewPageController via a route subscriber), for pre-rendered view elements, and via hook_views_pre_view for embedded views. It is offered as a simpler, in-view alternative to domain-specific config overrides, since Domain Config UI does not currently work with Views. It requires core Views and the contributed Domain module (>= 2.0) and is not covered by Drupal's security advisory policy.
